prose: Cloudflare released two open-weight decision models, Clef and Clef-flash, two weeks after TypeSafe's Jev took off. Like Jev they answer bounded questions: yes/no, multiple choice and rankings. They are built on frozen, post-trained Qwen3.8-27B and Qwen3.5-9B backbones, run a prefill-only pass and score options in parallel.
Cloudflare claims they beat Jev on speed and several benchmarks and handle images and video, at a higher price. Weights are on Hugging Face for local use. These are Cloudflare's own claims.
highlights: Clef and Clef-flash: open-weight decision models, multimodal.
Backbones: Qwen3.8-27B and Qwen3.5-9B, frozen and post-trained.
Answer yes/no, multiple choice and ranking questions.
Claimed faster and smarter than Jev; costs more.
